ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB=AC=6$, $\sin B=\frac{2}{3}$. Point D is on the extension line of side BC, and $CD=BC$. What is the value of $\tan D$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, draw $AE\perp BD$ at point E through point $A$.\\
$\therefore$ $\sin B=\frac{AE}{AB}=\frac{2}{3}$.\\
$\because$ $AB=AC=6$,\\
$\therefore$ $AE=4$,\\
$\therefore$ $BE=\sqrt{AB^{2}-AE^{2}}=2\sqrt{5}$.\\
$\because$ $AE\perp BD$, $AB=AC=6$,\\
$\therefore$ $CE=BE=2\sqrt{5}$,\\
$\therefore$ $CD=BC=BE+CE=4\sqrt{5}$,\\
$\therefore$ $DE=CD+CE=6\sqrt{5}$,\\
$\therefore$ $\tan D=\frac{AE}{DE}=\frac{4}{6\sqrt{5}}=\boxed{\frac{2\sqrt{5}}{15}}$

在三角形 ACD 中，∠ACD 是三角形 ABC 中 ∠C 的外角，所以 ∠ACD=180°-θ，故 cos∠ACD=-cos θ=-sqrt(5)/3。由余弦定理：AD^2=AC^2+CD^2-2·AC·CD·cos(180°-θ)=36+80-2·6·4sqrt(5)·(-sqrt(5)/3)=36+80+80=196，所以 AD=14。

再由正弦定理，AC 对应 ∠D，AD 对应 ∠ACD，因此 sin D/AC=sin(180°-θ)/AD=(2/3)/14，所以 sin D=6·(2/3)/14=2/7。

由余弦定理求 ∠D 的余弦：cos D=(AD^2+CD^2-AC^2)/(2·AD·CD)=(196+80-36)/(2·14·4sqrt(5))=3sqrt(5)/7。

因此 tan D=sin D/cos D=(2/7)/(3sqrt(5)/7)=2/(3sqrt(5))=2sqrt(5)/15。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB=AC=6$, $\sin B=\frac{2}{3}$. Point D is on the extension line of side BC, and $CD=BC$. What is the value of $\tan D$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, draw $AE\perp BD$ at point E through point $A$.\\
$\therefore$ $\sin B=\frac{AE}{AB}=\frac{2}{3}$.\\
$\because$ $AB=AC=6$,\\
$\therefore$ $AE=4$,\\
$\therefore$ $BE=\sqrt{AB^{2}-AE^{2}}=2\sqrt{5}$.\\
$\because$ $AE\perp BD$, $AB=AC=6$,\\
$\therefore$ $CE=BE=2\sqrt{5}$,\\
$\therefore$ $CD=BC=BE+CE=4\sqrt{5}$,\\
$\therefore$ $DE=CD+CE=6\sqrt{5}$,\\
$\therefore$ $\tan D=\frac{AE}{DE}=\frac{4}{6\sqrt{5}}=\boxed{\frac{2\sqrt{5}}{15}}$
